theorems.name: Submission.bf_coneDensity_top_projection_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact A → μHE[n] A < ∞ → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → μHE[n] (W.starProjection '' {a | a ∈ A ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < ε ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * (r * s) ^ n) ≤ μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖W.starProjection (x - a)‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r))}) = 0
